comments.body: On aarch64 this retry hides a product bug: [job 5123457](https://openqa.opensuse.org/tests/5123457) fails in every `*_product_increment*.yaml` schedule. The bug is [bsc#1234567](https://bugzilla.suse.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1234567), and os-autoinst/os-autoinst#3114 changes only the backend. Could the module record the bug as a soft failure instead of retrying?
